deploy.startCommand: echo "[start] PORT=[$PORT] uid=$(id -u) cwd=$(pwd)" && python manage.py migrate --noinput && echo "[start] migrations done, launching gunicorn on ${PORT:-8000}" && exec gunicorn --bind 0.0.0.0:${PORT:-8000} --workers 2 --threads 4 --worker-class gthread --timeout 120 --log-level info --access-logfile - --error-logfile - backend.wsgi:application
